description:
BLACK HALO COVEN

Join us. Transcend your limits. Achieve Perfection.

The Black Halo Coven is a new Midline faction for Starsector, built around the pursuit of one's own goals, power and perfection, and the belief that humanity was never meant to accept its limitations.

ASCENSION     •     POWER     •     PERFECTION

At any cost.

IDEOLOGY

The Church and Path misunderstood Ludd.

The Church chose stagnation.
The Path chose destruction.
We chose Ascension.

The Coven accepts that Ludd saw genuine dangers in humanity's dependence on technology. He was simply wrong about the answer.

Humanity should not retreat from progress. It should master it.

The Coven teaches that mankind's highest purpose is the pursuit of perfection. If cybernetics, genetic modification or other augmentations allow humanity to overcome its limitations, they should be embraced.

Machines exist to serve humanity, and even artificial intelligence may be used — carefully, under supervision and always subordinate to human will.

RELATIONS WITH THE SECTOR

Luddic Church — Hostile. The two faiths represent opposing answers to the legacy of Ludd.

Luddic Path — Hostile. To the Path, the Coven's embrace of augmentation and advanced technology is an abomination. To the Coven, the Path destroys what humanity should learn to master.

Hegemony — Poor relations. The Coven's limited use of AI cores remains a constant source of tension.

Persean League — Relatively friendly. Trade and diplomacy allow both factions to coexist despite ideological differences.

Sindrian Diktat — Relatively friendly. Pragmatic agreements and profitable trade keep relations stable.

Tri-Tachyon — Cautiously positive. Their shared interest in advanced technology creates common ground, even if neither side entirely trusts the other.

Independent Worlds — Generally friendly. The Coven maintains extensive trade and has little reason to interfere with independent colonies.

The Coven has far fewer followers than the Luddic Church, but careful diplomacy and trade agreements allow it to survive despite open conflict with both major Luddic factions and persistent tension with the Hegemony.

FLEET DOCTRINE

The Black Halo Coven is a Midline faction by philosophy as much as by technology.

The Coven does not bind itself to a single school of warfare. Ballistic, missile and energy weapons are all tools, and its fleets are expected to use whatever is best suited to overcoming the enemy before them.

The goal justifies the means.

At the same time, the Coven naturally favors more technologically advanced solutions. High-performance Midline and High Tech weaponry is generally preferred, while older Low Tech weapons see less frequent use unless they offer a clear practical advantage.

This philosophy is reflected in Coven ship design. Its hulls emphasize flexibility and support a wide variety of weapon combinations rather than being built around a single technological doctrine.

There is, however, one absolute exception.

The Coven will never use Hammer torpedoes.

Hammers have become inseparably associated with the Luddic Path and everything the Coven despises about its ideology. No tactical advantage is considered sufficient to justify their use.

For heavy strike roles, Coven fleets instead favor more advanced options such as Reaper torpedoes and Dragonfire missiles.

DOWNLOAD BLACK HALO COVEN
NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE

Current Version: 1.0.7
Starsector Version: 0.98a-RC8
Nexerelin: Supported

Mod Author: Osart

PATCH NOTES
1.0.7
- Fixed the BHC Radiant hull, weapon slots, and loadout; increased shield coverage to 360 degrees.
- Nerfed the Kirbo-pattern Luminarch: flux capacity reduced from 7,000 to 5,500.
- Added Ascension Gate to the Empyrean star system.

1.0.6
- Replaced the Acolyte sprite and updated its weapon slots and variants.
- Added the Deacon destroyer with two combat variants.
- Overhauled the Seraph.
- Reworked faction starting systems and planetary layouts, conditions, and infrastructure.

1.0.5
• Added BHC Kite, Wolf, Mule and Apogee refits with custom sprites and faction variants
• Added Captain Raid Iant the Human's bounty
• Increased Pilgrim Heavy Fighter wing cost to 14 OP
• Rebalanced all ship variants to use their full OP budgets
• Fixed weapon slot compatibility on Radiant and Seraph variants
• Updated Halo Missile AI behavior

1.0.4
• Completely reworked the Acolyte, including a new sprite and redesigned hull layout
• Added the Pilgrim Heavy Fighter
• Added the Missionary Torpedo Bomber
• Added the Halo Missile family: Halo Missile (Single), Halo Missile Rack and Halo SRM Pod
• Added the Black Halo Coven Blueprint Package
• Added Version Checker support
• Added Black Halo Coven faction music to fleet encounters
• Increased all Luminarch base values to 45,000 credits
• Increased the Ascendant base value to 270,000 credits
• Fixed the Acolyte Vanguard variant registration
• Removed Hammer torpedoes from Black Halo Coven faction weapon access and selection

1.0.3
• Updated ship naming
• Added additional maneuvering thrusters to the Seraph and Acolyte to better reflect their Maneuvering Jets systems
• Rebalanced Ascendant Ordnance Points
• Adjusted Ascendant weapon slots and firing arcs

1.0.2
• Added 10 custom bounties
• Added an additional variant for each ship
• Updated the Aris Pattern Luminarch sprite
• Updated the Cherub sprite
• Added multiple new descriptions
• Added 160 new character portraits

1.0.1
• Updated Archangel graphics and layout
• Updated Seraph graphics and layout
• Luminarch now features 3 distinct variants

AI use disclaimer

Some assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:

Code: ChatGPT 5.6 Sol
Portraits: ChatGPT 5.6 Sol
Ships: Kit bashed and painted personally
Faction music: done by Suno

As I learn coding and spriting, I want to eventually replace all of the AI assets with hand-made ones, but it will take me some time.

For now I started with ships and can proudly say that they were rebuilt so that they are fully hand-made now.

The build has been stable in my testing alongside 20+ other mods, with no issues so far.

Credits to Vexlia Artemiss, Aris, and kirb0o0 for creating Luminarch ship patterns for the mod.

My main goal is to create ships and a faction that feel like a natural part of vanilla Starsector.

Constructive feedback is highly appreciated. ;D
